name: Implement change
description: Implement an approved plan with test-first evidence, scoped writes, review, and verification.

states.description: Load the approved plan, confirm ownership and scope, and record the implementation boundary.
states.stopCondition: Stop before tests when the plan is absent, stale, or not explicitly approved.

states.description: Write the smallest test at the public seam and observe the intended missing-behavior failure.
states.stopCondition: Stop when the test does not fail for the intended missing behavior.

states.description: Make the smallest authorized implementation change within the declared ownership boundary.
states.stopCondition: Stop before writing when ownership, containment, or authorization is not verified.

states.description: Run the focused test to GREEN, then refactor only while preserving the passing behavior.
states.stopCondition: Stop at the smallest failing implementation state when focused tests are not GREEN.

states.description: Review correctness, scope, error paths, security, determinism, and cross-platform behavior.
states.stopCondition: Stop before independent review until self-review findings are resolved or dispositioned.

states.description: Obtain an independent review of behavior, authorization, and the exact diff.
states.stopCondition: Stop before verification while a Critical or High review finding remains unresolved.

states.description: Run focused and full checks, inspect the final files, and record unavailable checks as not run.
states.stopCondition: Stop successfully only with passing required checks and explicit evidence for every not-run check.

gates.requirement: The current plan is explicitly approved and its files are owned.
The focused test fails for the intended missing behavior.
The destination is contained, owned, and within the authorized scope.
Focused tests pass before and after any refactor.
Self-review covers security, scope, determinism, and error paths.
Independent review has no unresolved Critical or High finding.
Focused and full checks have recorded exit status and limitations.

successCriteria: The approved change passes RED, GREEN, review, and verification gates.
Only owned and authorized files changed, with exact evidence recorded.
